Parse CoachForce.json to extract Market Research Report documents: $ python3 - <<'PY' import json p='/root/DATA/products/CoachForce.json' with open(p) as f: data=json.load(f) # recursively find dicts with type == 'Market Research Report' items=[]  def walk(x, path=''):     if isinstance(x, dict):         if x.get('type')=='Market Research Report' or x.get('document_type')=='Market Research Report':             items.append((path,x))         for k,v in x.items():             walk(v, path + '/' + str(k))     elif isinstance(x, list):         for i,v in enumerate(x):             walk(v, path + f'[{i}]')  walk(data) print('found', len(items)) for path,obj in items[:20]:     print('---', path)     keys=[k for k in obj.keys() if k not in ('content','text','transcript')]     print('keys', keys)     for k in ['id','doc_id','title','name','url','link','created_by','author','authors','owner','reviewers','key_reviewers','approvers','requested_reviewers','date']:         if k in obj:             print(k, obj[k]) PY

Explore slack structure and locate competitor insight messages: $ python3 - <<'PY' import json,re p='/root/DATA/products/PersonalizeForce.json' with open(p) as f: data=json.load(f) slack=data['slack'] print('slack keys', slack.keys()) print('channels', len(slack.get('channels',[]))) # count messages nmsg=0 for ch in slack.get('channels',[]):     nmsg += len(ch.get('messages',[])) print('total messages', nmsg) # find messages containing strength/weakness/competitor pat=re.compile(r"(competitor|strength|weakness)", re.I) hits=[] for ch in slack.get('channels',[]):     cname=ch.get('name')     for m in ch.get('messages',[]):         txt=m.get('text','')         if pat.search(txt):             hits.append((cname,m.get('ts') or m.get('id'),m.get('user') or m.get('sender'),txt)) print('hits',len(hits)) for h in hits[:30]:     cname,mid,user,txt=h     print('---',cname,mid,user)     print(txt[:200].replace('\n',' ')) PY

Scan PersonalizeForce slack messages for competitor strengths/weaknesses phrases: $ python3 - <<'PY' import json,re p='/root/DATA/products/PersonalizeForce.json' with open(p) as f: data=json.load(f) entries=data['slack'] pat=re.compile(r"(PersonaAI|SmartSuggest|TailorAI|competitor|strengths?|weaknesses?)",re.I) hits=[] for e in entries:     msg=e.get('Message',{})     user=msg.get('User',{})     txt=user.get('text','')     if pat.search(txt):         hits.append((e.get('Channel',{}).get('name'), user.get('utterranceID') or e.get('id'), user.get('userId'), txt)) # also check thread replies for e in entries:     for r in e.get('ThreadReplies',[]) or []:         user=r.get('User',{})         txt=user.get('text','')         if pat.search(txt):             hits.append((e.get('Channel',{}).get('name'), user.get('utterranceID'), user.get('userId'), txt))  print('hits',len(hits)) for h in hits[:60]:     ch,mid,uid,txt=h     print('---',ch,mid,uid)     print(txt.replace('\n',' ')[:220]) PY

Extract unique employee IDs from slack messages about competitor strengths/weaknesses: $ python3 - <<'PY' import json,re p='/root/DATA/products/PersonalizeForce.json' with open(p) as f: data=json.load(f) entries=data['slack'] pat=re.compile(r"(PersonaAI|SmartSuggest|TailorAI)",re.I) kw=re.compile(r"(strengths?|weaknesses?)",re.I) res=[] for e in entries:     ch=e.get('Channel',{}).get('name')     mu=e.get('Message',{}).get('User',{})     txt=mu.get('text','')     uid=mu.get('userId')     if uid and pat.search(txt) and kw.search(txt):         res.append((uid,ch,mu.get('utterranceID'),txt))     for r in e.get('ThreadReplies',[]) or []:         u=r.get('User',{})         txt=u.get('text','')         uid=u.get('userId')         if uid and pat.search(txt) and kw.search(txt):             res.append((uid,ch,u.get('utterranceID'),txt))  print('messages matching competitor+strength/weakness:',len(res)) for uid,ch,mid,txt in res:     print('---',uid,ch,mid)     print(txt.replace('\n',' ')[:200])  print('\nunique uids:',sorted(set(uid for uid,_,_,_ in res))) PY

Find unique employees discussing competitor products (excluding pure demo-share posts): $ python3 - <<'PY' import json,re p='/root/DATA/products/PersonalizeForce.json' with open(p) as f: data=json.load(f) entries=data['slack'] comp=re.compile(r"\b(PersonaAI|SmartSuggest|TailorAI)\b",re.I) demo=re.compile(r"demo available here|/demo\b",re.I) # collect messages discussing competitors; exclude pure demo-share lines that are just '@here take a look ... demo ...' insight_msgs=[] for e in entries:     ch=e.get('Channel',{}).get('name')     mu=e.get('Message',{}).get('User',{})     txt=(mu.get('text') or '').strip()     uid=mu.get('userId')     if uid and comp.search(txt):         # exclude if it's basically just a demo share (short and contains demo)         if demo.search(txt) and len(txt)<120:             pass         else:             insight_msgs.append((uid,ch,mu.get('utterranceID'),txt))     for r in e.get('ThreadReplies',[]) or []:         u=r.get('User',{})         txt=(u.get('text') or '').strip()         uid=u.get('userId')         if uid and comp.search(txt):             if demo.search(txt) and len(txt)<120:                 pass             else:                 insight_msgs.append((uid,ch,u.get('utterranceID'),txt))  uids=sorted(set(uid for uid,_,_,_ in insight_msgs if uid and uid.startswith('eid_'))) print('insight msg count',len(insight_msgs)) print('unique uids',uids) # show a few messages per uid from collections import defaultdict by=defaultdict(list) for uid,ch,mid,txt in insight_msgs:     by[uid].append((ch,mid,txt)) for uid in uids:     print('\n===',uid,'examples',len(by[uid]))     for ch,mid,txt in by[uid][:2]:         print('-',ch,mid,txt[:180].replace('\n',' ')) PY

Extract competitor demo URLs from PersonalizeForce slack messages: $ python3 - <<'PY' import json,re p='/root/DATA/products/PersonalizeForce.json' with open(p) as f: data=json.load(f) entries=data['slack'] # match demo messages that share external demo links url_re=re.compile(r"https?://[^\s>]+") comp_re=re.compile(r"\b(PersonaAI|SmartSuggest|TailorAI)\b",re.I) demo_re=re.compile(r"demo available here",re.I) urls=[] for e in entries:     mu=e.get('Message',{}).get('User',{})     txt=mu.get('text','') or ''     if demo_re.search(txt) and comp_re.search(txt):         urls += url_re.findall(txt)     for r in e.get('ThreadReplies',[]) or []:         u=r.get('User',{})         txt=u.get('text','') or ''         if demo_re.search(txt) and comp_re.search(txt):             urls += url_re.findall(txt) # de-dup preserving order seen=set(); out=[] for u in urls:     if u not in seen:         seen.add(u); out.append(u) print(out) PY

Compute ordered list of competitor insight contributors by earliest message date: $ python3 - <<'PY' import json,re from datetime import datetime p='/root/DATA/products/PersonalizeForce.json' with open(p) as f: data=json.load(f) entries=data['slack'] comp=re.compile(r"\b(PersonaAI|SmartSuggest|TailorAI)\b",re.I) demo=re.compile(r"demo available here|/demo\b",re.I) # extract insight messages (exclude short demo shares) ins=[] for e in entries:     for obj in [e.get('Message',{}).get('User',{})] + [r.get('User',{}) for r in (e.get('ThreadReplies') or [])]:         uid=obj.get('userId')         txt=(obj.get('text') or '').strip()         mid=obj.get('utterranceID')         if uid and uid.startswith('eid_') and comp.search(txt):             if demo.search(txt) and len(txt)<120:                 continue             ins.append((uid,mid,txt))  def parse_mid(mid):     # format YYYYMMDD-idx-hash     try:         return datetime.strptime(mid.split('-')[0],'%Y%m%d')     except Exception:         return datetime.max  first={} for uid,mid,txt in ins:     d=parse_mid(mid)     first[uid]=min(first.get(uid,datetime.max), d)  ordered=sorted(first.items(), key=lambda x:x[1]) print('ordered uids:',[u for u,_ in ordered]) PY

Generate /root/answer.json with answers and estimated token counts: $ python3 - <<'PY' import json, math answers={   'q1': ['eid_890654c4','eid_99835861','eid_50da4819','eid_ee9ca887','eid_8df92d08','eid_85a4de81','eid_965867b8','eid_59bbe6f6'],   'q2': ['eid_c9c3d8d5','eid_5318af37','eid_d2f0f99a','eid_fce6544f','eid_a253c65a'],   'q3': ['https://personaai.com/demo','https://smartsuggest.com/demo','https://tailorai.com/demo'], }  def est_tokens(x):     s=json.dumps(x, ensure_ascii=False)     return int(math.ceil(len(s)/4))  out={} for q,a in answers.items():     out[q]={'answer':a,'tokens':est_tokens(a)}  with open('/root/answer.json','w') as f:     json.dump(out,f,indent=4)  print('wrote /root/answer.json') print(json.dumps(out,indent=2)) PY
